comments.text: Reuse note (rust_scriptbots survey, 2026-11-08; same author, rust_scriptbots@8a7e9c70): VERIFIED FrankenSQLite lesson: without an ambient asupersync Cx, fsqlite's unix VFS spawns a new OS thread per I/O (statements ~0.5 s, commits ~0.8 s under load).
